_note: Single source of truth for the hub's 'Use the city' grid (hub.btownbrief.com renders from this file at load). When you launch a new guide page, add a card here — the hub picks it up automatically. Full URLs on purpose: a few cards point at play.btownbrief.com or elsewhere. Keep blurbs in the hub's voice: short, concrete, second person.
